entities.name: Capybara
entities.description: Large social semiaquatic rodents that inhabit Ixalan.

entities.name: Nelli
entities.description: An Oltec didact who believes even the most learned philosophers can only approach the serenity of the capybara.

entities.name: Kusi
entities.description: An Oltec gardener who remarked that a wrecked temple roof was due to be replaced.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: People of Ixalan whose temple roof was wrecked.

events.summary: A spell massively enlarges a capybara atop an Oltec temple, wrecking its roof.
events.quote: A spell once massively increased the size of a Capybara on top of one of the Oltec's temples, wrecking its roof
